title: Add time off, breaks or temporary hours
summary: Set dated absences or working exceptions and review their appointment impact.

sections.title: Add a schedule exception
sections.body:
1. Open the person in **Team & availability** and select **Schedule**.
2. Under **Breaks & dated exceptions**, choose **Add break**, **Time off** or **Temporary hours**.
3. Choose **Type** and **Branch**. Time off can apply to all assigned branches; temporary working hours require a branch.
4. For a dated change, enter **From date** and **Through date**. For a recurring break or unavailable block, choose **Repeat → Every week** and a day.
5. Use **Full day** for a whole-day absence, or enter **Starts** and **Ends**. Add an optional **Private reason**.
6. Select **Add to schedule review**, then **Review changes**.
7. Resolve or explicitly retain affected appointments with a reason, then select **Save reviewed schedule**.

sections.title: How exceptions work
sections.body: Temporary working hours replace that day’s regular hours; they do not add a second independent schedule. Breaks and time off remove bookable time. Private reasons are visible only to authorized team managers. This screen does not provide an HR approval or payroll process.

sections.title: Check and correct the result
sections.body: Use the **Time off** view or reopen Schedule to verify the dates and branches. To remove an upcoming exception, select its **Remove** action, then review and save the revised schedule. Past exceptions remain part of history. If holds or new bookings block saving, review again after resolving them.
